entries.en: Man, I've already seen that one like[n]fifty times, but the audio in the theater[n]STILL impresses me!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Y'know, sci-fi's more than just some[n]crazy made-up baloney.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: It's like... a dream that might end up[n]coming true one day. I guess it's almost[n]like hope! You get me?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: In any case, thanks for chilling!
